name: Cerebras Inference
tagline: The fastest inference you can buy — but as of 2026, no longer the best thing you can get for free.
quota: $5 in one-time trial credits. This is not a daily token allowance — every call is billed against the credit.
limits: 5 RPM · 30K TPM uncached (90K total) · 1M tokens/day ceiling, on gpt-oss-120b and gemma-4-31b.
expiry: Credits expire 30 days after being granted, spent or not.
path: cloud.cerebras.ai → sign up → add a payment method (required to activate) → API Keys → Create key
code:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(api_key="csk-xxx", base_url="https://api.cerebras.ai/v1")
r = client.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-oss-120b", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
verdict: Cerebras retired its no-card free tier in 2026. What remains is a $5 trial that needs a card and dies in 30 days. Plenty of sites still list it as "no card, 1M tokens/day" — that stopped being true. Come here for speed, not for free.
